body.text: I have carried the charge on this arrangement out of my own establishment for some months now. I did not write about it because I thought you would notice.
It is {param:cost} a month. I am not a poor man and I am not asking for sympathy. I am telling you what it has cost, which is a thing you could not have known and can now no longer say you did not.
I will carry it {param:months} months more. After that I shall let it lapse, and I would rather write you this letter than that one.
I have taken no pleasure in composing this.
You will understand that my forbearance is not a renewable resource.

options.text: and am sorry it took a letter
and can only tell you how little there is
and note the tone of it

steps.prompt: What the Crown will bear from here

options.label: take the whole charge onto the Crown
options.text: The whole of it falls on the Crown from this month{insert:warmth}. You should not have had to ask, and I shall not make you ask twice.

warmth.pleased: , with my thanks for carrying it this long

options.label: take half, and send something for the trouble
options.text: Half the charge from this month, and {param:cost} besides for what you have already carried. I would rather square the account than argue about it.

options.label: take half, and say plainly there is no more
options.text: Half, and not because it is fair. It is what there is, and I would rather tell you the truth about it than promise you the rest and fail.

options.label: let it lapse, and thank him
options.text: Let it lapse. You have carried it longer than I had any right to expect, and I will not have you beggar yourself for a thing the Treasury should have paid for.

tone.hateful: The account is settled. Do not raise it again.
